# OmniScout Docs (full text)

Site: https://docs.omniscout.xyz
Generated for LLM crawlers. Prefer /llms.txt for the index.

---
URL: https://docs.omniscout.xyz/cli/overview/
Source: content/en/1.cli/1.overview.md
---
OmniScout gives AI agents the ability to search the web, extract content, control browsers, and automate desktop tasks — all locally, no cloud required.

## Install

```bash
pip install omniscout
omniscout install --skill
```

## Use

```bash
# Start the daemon (once)
omniscout daemon start

# Search the web
omniscout answer "what is the capital of france"

# Extract content from a URL
omniscout extract https://example.com

# Control a browser
omniscout browser navigate https://example.com
omniscout browser snapshot --refs-only
omniscout browser click '@e3'
omniscout browser screenshot --out /tmp/page.png

# Research a topic
omniscout research "AI agents in 2026"

# Build a knowledge graph
omniscout graph "Cursor"
```

## What you can do

| Command | What it does |
|---------|--------------|
| `search` | Web search with optional semantic rerank |
| `answer` | Direct Q&A with citations (preferred over `search`) |
| `extract` | Fetch a URL and return clean Markdown |
| `research` | Multi-step: search → crawl → extract → summarize |
| `graph` | Build a structured knowledge graph |
| `browser` | Control a browser (navigate, click, fill, screenshot) |
| `computer` | Desktop automation (macOS) |
| `remember` | Store URLs in browser memory for later recall |
| `install` | First-time setup |
| `daemon` | Manage the background service |

## Next steps

- [Using with AI agents](/en/cli/agents) — drop-in prompts for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex
- [Commands reference](/en/cli/commands) — every verb, every flag
- [Examples & recipes](/en/cli/examples) — common workflows

---
URL: https://docs.omniscout.xyz/cli/agents/
Source: content/en/1.cli/2.agents.md
---
OmniScout is built for AI agents to drive. Here's how to set it up.

## 1. Install

```bash
pip install omniscout
omniscout install --skill
```

The `--skill` flag copies instructions into your agent's skill directory:

| Agent | Location |
|---|---|
| Claude Code | `~/.claude/skills/scout/SKILL.md` |
| Cursor | `~/.cursor/skills-cursor/scout/SKILL.md` |
| Codex | `~/.codex/skills/scout/SKILL.md` |

The agent picks it up automatically on next session.

## 2. Start the daemon

```bash
omniscout daemon start
```

## 3. Drop a prompt

### Research a question

```text
Use OmniScout to research "state of open-source browser agents in 2026" and summarize the top 5 passages with their source URLs.
```

### Navigate and click

```text
Open https://news.ycombinator.com using OmniScout, snapshot interactive elements, click the top story, and screenshot the result to /tmp/hn-top.png.
```

### Log in once and reuse

```text
Run `omniscout browser login https://github.com --profile work`, pause for me to authenticate, then screenshot my notifications page with that profile.
```

### Build a knowledge graph

```text
Build a knowledge graph for "Cursor" with OmniScout. Run `omniscout graph "Cursor" --json --data`, show the tree, and cite sources.
```

### Fill a form

```text
Use OmniScout to open https://duckduckgo.com, fill the search box with "local-first AI agents", press Enter, wait for results, and list the top 5 results.
```

### Capture network traffic

```text
Open the Vercel pricing page with OmniScout, capture network traffic while scrolling, then list requests matching stripe|payment|checkout.
```

## Tips for agents

- Set `OMNISCOUT_JSON=1` at the start for structured output
- Use `omniscout browser snapshot --refs-only` to find elements, then click by `@eN` ref
- Re-snapshot after every `navigate` — refs go stale
- Close sessions with `omniscout browser close --all` when done

---
URL: https://docs.omniscout.xyz/cli/examples/
Source: content/en/1.cli/3.examples.md
---
Copy-paste recipes for common tasks.

## Quick reference

```bash
omniscout daemon start                              # 1. start the daemon
omniscout browser navigate https://example.com      # 2. drive the browser
omniscout browser snapshot --refs-only              # 3. find @eN refs
omniscout browser click '@e3'                       # 4. act on them
omniscout browser screenshot --out /tmp/out.png     # 5. capture state
omniscout browser close --all                       # 6. clean up
```

## Search and answer

```bash
# One-line factual answer
omniscout answer "who is the prime minister of india"
omniscout answer "what is the capital of france"

# Web search with ranked hits
omniscout search "AI agents 2026" --limit 5
```

## Extract content from a page

```bash
omniscout extract https://example.com > /tmp/page.md
```

## Research a topic

```bash
omniscout research "vector database benchmarks 2026" --results 10
```

## Build a knowledge graph

```bash
omniscout graph "Cursor"
omniscout graph "cursor.com"          # site-only mode
```

## Navigate and interact

```bash
omniscout browser navigate https://news.ycombinator.com
omniscout browser snapshot --refs-only
omniscout browser click '@e3'
omniscout browser screenshot --out /tmp/hn.png
omniscout browser close --all
```

## Fill a form

```bash
omniscout browser navigate https://duckduckgo.com
omniscout browser snapshot --refs-only
SEARCH_REF=$(jq -r '.refs[] | select(.role == "searchbox") | .ref' | head -1)
omniscout browser fill "$SEARCH_REF" "local-first AI agents"
omniscout browser key Enter
```

## Log in and reuse a profile

```bash
# Terminal A: opens browser, blocks
omniscout browser login https://github.com/login --profile work

# Terminal B (after you log in):
omniscout browser login --done

# Now reuse the profile
omniscout browser navigate https://github.com/notifications --profile work
omniscout browser screenshot --out /tmp/notifs.png
```

## Capture network requests

```bash
omniscout browser network start
omniscout browser navigate https://vercel.com/pricing
omniscout browser scroll down --amount 10
omniscout browser network stop
omniscout browser network list --filter "stripe|payment"
```

## Take a full-page screenshot

```bash
omniscout browser screenshot https://example.com --full-length --out /tmp/full.png
```

## Multiple tabs

```bash
omniscout browser navigate https://example.com --session multi
omniscout browser navigate https://news.ycombinator.com --new-tab --session multi
omniscout browser tab list --session multi
omniscout browser tab switch 0 --session multi
```

## JSON for agents

```bash
export OMNISCOUT_JSON=1

omniscout search "topic"          | jq '.hits[] | {title, url}'
omniscout browser snapshot        | jq '.refs[] | select(.role == "button")'
omniscout extract https://...     | jq '{title, word_count}'
omniscout research "topic"        | jq '.passages[0:3]'
```

---
URL: https://docs.omniscout.xyz/cli/commands/
Source: content/en/1.cli/4.commands.md
---
Use `omniscout --help` to see all commands, or `omniscout <command> --help` for options.

## Top-level commands

| Command | What it does | When to use |
|---------|--------------|-------------|
| `search` | Web search with optional semantic rerank | Quick lookup of URLs or facts |
| `answer` | Retrieve web results and synthesize with an LLM | Direct Q&A with citation. Preferred over `search` |
| `map` | Crawl a site and produce a URL map | Explore a whole domain |
| `warmup` | Pre-load embedding/answer models in the daemon | Reduce latency for first calls |
| `remember` | Visit a URL, extract content, store in browser memory | Persist information for later recall |
| `extract` | Fetch a URL or query and return readable/structured data | Pull raw text or JSON from a page |
| `open` | Open a URL or the latest search-result index in the managed browser | Run a page in the controlled Chromium |
| `snapshot` | Capture an accessibility snapshot with `@e` refs | Inspect page structure for later UI actions |
| `context` | Show current workflow continuity state | Debug or resume a multi-step flow |
| `reset` | Reset the continuity state | Start a fresh session |
| `auto` | Auto-route input to the best command | Simple one-liner use |
| `research` | Multi-step: search → crawl → extract → rerank → summarize | Full research pipelines |
| `graph` | Build a structured knowledge graph for an entity | Organise facts into nodes/edges |
| `install` | Verify (or download) a Chromium browser for automation | First-time setup |
| `settings` | View / change user settings | Configuration tweaks |
| `browser` | Direct Playwright-based Chromium automation | Complex web UI workflows |
| `computer` | Native desktop automation (macOS) | Interact with OS apps, files, clipboard, etc. |
| `daemon` | Manage the long-lived browser-control daemon | Start/stop the background service |
| `index` | Manage the local search index | Re-index or query local cache |
| `crawl` | Run / inspect local crawl jobs | Bulk site crawling |
| `record` | Record daemon actions into a named macro | Create reusable scripts |
| `macro` | List / run saved macros | Replay recorded actions |
| `replay` | Replay recorded browser actions | Debug or repeat a flow |
| `workflow` | Export / view continuity workflow | Persist or share a process |
| `monitor` | Continuously monitor a URL for changes | Alert on content updates |
| `profile` | Manage persistent browser profiles | Separate contexts (work vs personal) |
| `session` | Manage long-lived browser sessions | Keep cookies/logins across runs |
| `memory` | Browser memory – remembered visits & notes | Retrieve stored snippets |

## Global options

All commands support:

- `--json` — emit machine-readable JSON to stdout
- `--verbose`, `-v` — verbose stderr logging
- `--version` — print version and exit

Set `OMNISCOUT_JSON=1` in the environment to make JSON output the default.

## Browser commands

| Command | What it does |
|---------|--------------|
| `browser navigate <url>` | Open a URL in the active tab |
| `browser snapshot --refs-only` | Get interactive elements with `@eN` refs |
| `browser click <ref>` | Click an element by `@eN` ref |
| `browser fill <ref> <value>` | Fill a form field |
| `browser type <ref> <text>` | Type text into a field |
| `browser scroll [up\|down]` | Scroll the page |
| `browser key <combo>` | Press a keyboard shortcut |
| `browser screenshot [-o PATH]` | Take a screenshot |
| `browser pdf [-o PATH]` | Generate a PDF |
| `browser wait text <substring>` | Wait for text to appear |
| `browser login <url>` | Open headful login window |
| `browser captcha` | Detect or solve CAPTCHAs |
| `browser close --all` | Close all sessions |

## Computer commands (macOS)

| Command | What it does |
|---------|--------------|
| `computer navigate <target>` | Open an app, file, or URL |
| `computer type <text>` | Type into the focused window |
| `computer key <combo>` | Send a keyboard shortcut |
| `computer screenshot` | Capture the screen |
| `computer clipboard get` | Read the clipboard |
| `computer clipboard set <text>` | Write to the clipboard |
| `computer window list` | List open windows |
| `computer window activate <title>` | Bring a window to foreground |
| `computer ui snapshot` | Get UI element refs |
| `computer ui click <ref>` | Click a UI element |

## Environment variables

| Variable | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `OMNISCOUT_JSON=1` | Force JSON output on every command |
| `OMNISCOUT_DAEMON_AUTO_START=0` | Don't auto-start the daemon |
| `OMNISCOUT_DAEMON_PORT` | Override the daemon port (default 7720) |
| `OMNISCOUT_DATA_DIR` | Override data dir |

---
URL: https://docs.omniscout.xyz/cli/architecture/
Source: content/en/1.cli/5.architecture.md
---
OmniScout has three parts:

1. **CLI** — the `omniscout` command you type
2. **Daemon** — a long-lived background process that holds the browser open
3. **Backends** — Playwright (default) or Chrome extension

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  CLI["CLI — omniscout command"] -->|"HTTP POST"| Daemon["Daemon — background process"]
  Daemon --> Playwright["Playwright (default)"]
  Daemon --> Extension["Chrome extension (opt-in)"]
  Playwright --> Browser["Browser"]
  Extension --> Browser
```

## Key concepts

### `@eN` refs

When you run `snapshot`, OmniScout returns the page's accessibility tree with stable element refs (`@e1`, `@e2`, ...). Use these to click, fill, or interact — they survive CSS changes.

### Daemon

The daemon keeps Playwright warm so every action is sub-second. Start it once with `omniscout daemon start`.

### Backends

- **Playwright** (default): OmniScout launches its own Chrome with a persistent profile
- **Chrome extension** (opt-in): Drives your real Chrome with your real logins

### Profiles

Persistent browser profiles store cookies and login state. Create one with `omniscout profile create work`, then use `--profile work` on every command.

## Data location

| Platform | Path |
|---|---|
| macOS | `~/Library/Application Support/omniscout/` |
| Linux | `~/.local/share/omniscout/` |

Override with `OMNISCOUT_DATA_DIR`.

---
URL: https://docs.omniscout.xyz/cli/troubleshooting/
Source: content/en/1.cli/7.troubleshooting.md
---
## `@eN` ref not found

The page changed since your last `snapshot`. Re-snapshot and use the new ref:

```bash
omniscout browser snapshot --refs-only
omniscout browser click '@e7'
```

## Login never completes

Use the `--done` signal from another shell:

```bash
# Terminal A:
omniscout browser login https://app.example.com --profile work

# Terminal B (after you log in):
omniscout browser login --done
```

## CAPTCHA blocks forever

Solve it in the headful window, or use a third-party solver:

```bash
export TWOCAPTCHA_API_KEY=...
omniscout browser captcha --solver 2captcha
```

## Extension says `backend_unavailable`

1. Open `chrome://extensions` — confirm the extension is loaded
2. Click the extension icon — reconnect if disconnected
3. Or drop `--backend extension` to use Playwright instead

## Python version error

```bash
python --version  # needs 3.11+
pip install omniscout
```

## Chrome not found

```bash
omniscout settings browsers          # see what's installed
omniscout settings set browser edge  # or brave, vivaldi, etc.
```

## Daemon won't start

```bash
omniscout daemon stop
omniscout daemon start
lsof -i :7720                       # check if port is in use
omniscout daemon start --port 7721   # use different port
```

## Search returns no results

```bash
omniscout search "more specific query"
omniscout search "query" --source ddg
```

## Screenshot is blank

```bash
# Wait for loading
omniscout browser screenshot https://example.com --delay 3 --out /tmp/page.png

# Full page
omniscout browser screenshot https://example.com --full-length --out /tmp/full.png
```

## FAQ

**Is my data sent to the cloud?**
No. The only outbound traffic is DuckDuckGo searches and URLs you explicitly fetch. A one-time model download is cached locally.

**Can I use OmniScout without Chrome?**
You need a Chromium-family browser. Install Chrome/Chromium, or configure a custom path with `omniscout install --browser custom --browser-executable <path>`.

**How do I update?**
```bash
pip install --upgrade omniscout
```

**How do I clear all data?**
```bash
rm -rf ~/Library/Application\ Support/omniscout/   # macOS
rm -rf ~/.local/share/omniscout/                   # Linux
```

**Where do I get help?**
- [CLI overview](/en/cli/overview)
- [Examples](/en/cli/examples)
- [GitHub issues](https://github.com/sriramramnath/omniscout/issues)

## What's in the box

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `omniscout answer` | Direct Q&A with citations |
| `omniscout search` | Web search with reranking |
| `omniscout extract` | Fetch a URL and return clean content |
| `omniscout research` | Multi-step research pipeline |
| `omniscout graph` | Build a knowledge graph |
| `omniscout browser` | Control a browser |
| `omniscout computer` | Desktop automation (macOS) |
| `omniscout remember` | Store URLs in memory |
| `omniscout daemon` | Manage the background service |

## JSON output

```bash
export OMNISCOUT_JSON=1  # structured output for agents
```

## Local-first

No cloud account, API key, or hosted server required. The only outbound traffic is DuckDuckGo searches and URLs you explicitly fetch.

# Python API Reference

## Installation

```bash
pip install omniscout
```

## Search API

```python
from omniscout.engines.search import ddg

results = ddg.search("python async patterns", limit=10)
for hit in results:
    print(f"{hit.title}: {hit.url}")
```

## Extraction API

```python
from omniscout.engines.extractor import extract_url

result = extract_url("https://example.com")
print(f"Title: {result.title}")
print(f"Word count: {result.word_count}")
print(result.content)  # Markdown
```

## Research API

```python
from omniscout.engines.research import run_research

report = run_research(topic="AI agents", depth=1, results=8)
print(report.summary)
for passage in report.passages[:5]:
    print(f"- {passage.text[:100]}...")
```

## Browser API

```python
from omniscout.client import DaemonClient

client = DaemonClient()
client.navigate(url="https://example.com", session="default")
client.click(selector="button.submit", session="default")
client.screenshot(session="default", output_path="result.png")
```

## Configuration API

```python
from omniscout.config import get_settings, get_paths

settings = get_settings()
paths = get_paths()
print(f"Data dir: {paths.data}")
print(f"Search limit: {settings.search_limit}")
```

## Error handling

```python
from omniscout.client import DaemonClient, DaemonError

client = DaemonClient()
try:
    result = client.navigate(url="https://example.com", session="nonexistent")
except DaemonError as e:
    print(f"Error: {e}")
    print(f"Kind: {e.kind}")
```

URL: https://docs.omniscout.xyz/sdk/

The OmniScout SDK lets you use OmniScout's search, extraction, and browser engines directly from Python code.

## Install

```bash
pip install omniscout
```

## Quick example

```python
from omniscout.engines.search import ddg

results = ddg.search("python async patterns", limit=10)
for hit in results:
    print(f"{hit.title}: {hit.url}")
```

## Search

```python
from omniscout.engines.search import ddg

results = ddg.search("topic", limit=5)
for hit in results:
    print(f"{hit.title}: {hit.url}")
```

## Extract

```python
from omniscout.engines.extractor import extract_url

result = extract_url("https://example.com")
print(result.content)  # Markdown
```

## Research

```python
from omniscout.engines.research import run_research

report = run_research(topic="AI agents", depth=1, results=8)
print(report.summary)
```

## Browser automation

```python
from omniscout.client import DaemonClient

client = DaemonClient()
client.navigate(url="https://example.com", session="default")
client.click(selector="button.submit", session="default")
client.screenshot(session="default", output_path="result.png")
```

::u-page-section
#title
Where OmniScout sits

#description
These products ship the reasoning model with the actuator. OmniScout deliberately does not — bring whatever LLM you want.

#body
| Product | Where it runs | What OmniScout borrows |
|---|---|---|
| Kimi WebBridge | Local daemon + Chrome extension | `@eN` refs, `/status` shape, optional extension backend |
| Claude for Chrome | MV3 side panel | Hybrid `@eN` + coordinates, click/key/scroll vocabulary |
| ChatGPT Atlas | Forked Chromium | Per-session tab groups, persistent login |
| browser-use | Playwright in-process | Backend-agnostic action surface, persistent profiles |
::
